_comment: wave 38: the 3 tgeo-family windowed transforms with CONSTANT args, on the wave-37 tgeotransform fold. Const literals travel as strings from the parser constantBuilder (string literals have quotes stripped, line 3603) and are parsed in the plain-C finalize: interval_in / timestamptz_in / (interpType)atoi / atof / bool. interptype enum (probed v17): DISCRETE=1, STEP=2, LINEAR=3. All return a Temporal* (TSequenceSet* is a Temporal subtype) serialized as EWKB hex. Const args listed in MEOS signature order.

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_tsample (Temporal* -> hex-WKB) - the windowed trajectory resampled at a fixed interval from an origin, with the given interpolation.
temporal_stops (Temporal* -> hex-WKB) - the windowed trajectory's stop subsequences (within maxdist for at least minduration).
temporal_segm_duration (Temporal* -> hex-WKB) - the windowed trajectory split into segments of the given duration.
